verdict.rationale: Cline supports autonomous, headless build/test workflows (terminal execution reacting to live output, CI/CD integration, cron-scheduled runs) and a web-based Kanban board for running multiple agents in parallel with per-card worktrees and auto-commit, plus diff-based review in the IDE. However, there's no evidence of a dedicated cloud-hosted execution environment (vs. local/CI runners) or of an explicit 'demo' artifact (e.g., preview links, screenshots, walkthroughs) being generated for stakeholder review. missing for 10: dedicated cloud compute/sandbox for agent runs, an explicit demo/preview generation feature, and independent evidence of a full build-test-demo cycle being used in practice.
